#include <iostream>

int main() {
    std::ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);

    int w, m;
    std::cin >> w >> m;

    bool ok = true;
    while (true) {
        if (m == 0) {
            break;
        }
        int d = m % w;
        if (d == 0 || d == 1) {
            m = (d == 1) ? (m - 1) / w : m / w;
        } else if (d == w - 1) {
            m = (m + 1) / w;
        } else {
            ok = false;
            break;
        }
    }

    std::cout << (ok ? "YES" : "NO") << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
